newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CITY HOTELS NETS $20 MILLION IN SALE OF TWO HOTELS.
newsitem.headline: CITY HOTELS NETS $20 MILLION IN SALE OF TWO HOTELS.

text.p: Belgium's City Hotels group said on Thursday it had booked a net capital gain of around $20 million from the sale of two hotels in the United States.

It said the sales of the Hilton Hotel in Durham, North Carolina and the Doubletree in Salt Lake City, Iowa, would formally take place in January but that the agreements it had just signed were definitive.
An affiliate of the American General Hospitality Operating Partnership has bought the Hilton, and a unit of the Wyndham Development Corp the Doubletree.
City Hotels said the capital gains realised on the Doubletree, acquired in July 1993, and the Hilton, acquired in September 1995, amounted to 10 times the shareholders equity invested in them.
"Those transactions will allow us to reduce the debt financing of the group by more than one billion Belgian francs," City Hotels chairman Victor Hasson, said in a statement.
"It will also generate new funds for expanding our U.S. hotel activities and our airline City Bird," he added.
